questions.scenario: What does create_worktree() create for each task?
options: A git branch and isolated working directory
questions.explanation: Each task gets a git worktree with its own branch (task/{task_id}) and working directory.

questions.scenario: What does compute_delta() return when nothing changed?
questions.explanation: When no fields differ between snapshots, the delta has empty changed_fields and has_changes=False.

questions.scenario: Why send environment deltas instead of full snapshots?
options: Deltas save context tokens and prevent information overload
Deltas are required by the API
questions.explanation: Deltas send only changed fields, saving context token budget.
